title: “It’s Not the Same Dollar”: The Big Lie Behind the Stock Market Rally
summary: After the stellar 2010s, the bond market performance has been disappointing in the 2020s. According to technical analyst Francis Hunt, this post-2020 rout marks the end of a 40-year debt bull market.
